title: OpenCampus · UO Eugene
description: Explore a stylized UO campus with photo-informed landmarks and softly veiled low-poly surroundings.
source_description: Oregon DOGAMI / NOAA Digital Coast. Historical survey: 2008-08-31. Nine source tiles cover the main campus and surrounding context.
about_summary: Five photo-informed landmarks include Knight Library, EMU, Johnson Hall, Gerlinger Hall and Gerlinger Annex. All 534 historical building records have stylized appearance: 135 in the campus art-priority region and 399 in the background. Seeded low-poly archetypes retain source positions and footprints. There are 600 illustrative trees; 300 pilot trees use archived 2024 NAIP cues and 300 additional trees are procedurally inferred. Local iteration 12 added style-inferred roofs across all source identities; semantic activity paths, seeded NPC traits, developer inspection and optional Zombie School beta. Local iteration 13 adds blue sky with soft block clouds, adjustable first-person motion, pedestrian detours, Zombie School restart, and a full-extent inferred ground-cover layer using an additional archived 2024 NAIP aerial reference. Local iteration 14 fixes distant depth flicker and reduces repeated label, static-transform, minimap and coordinate-display work without simplifying the scene.
about_limitations: This is a recognizable first-pass art model, refined through long-term correction. Facade dimensions, hidden sides, roof details and tree heights/species include plausible inference. The aerial image guides illustrative canopy distribution, not surveyed individual trees. Photos span different years; EMU combines historical and later design motifs. No new field measurements or photogrammetric solve were performed. Base terrain/roof candidates retain 2008 provenance; Census roads have estimated widths. Stairs, terraces and planting are decorative, not a surveyed navigation mesh. The square extent is not a property boundary. The art-priority polygon is not an official campus boundary. Background archetypes, roof forms and palettes are illustrative, not identified real building types. Trees retain their previous illustrative placements. The additional full-extent 2024 NAIP image supplies broad ground-color cues; pavement, lawns and urban parcels are plausible stylized inference, not measured land use or present access. Background haze is a visual effect and does not change the exported geographic geometry. New roof form/material/seam/equipment details are plausible style inference without new photographic evidence. Activity surfaces/parking and tree climbing are authored illustrations, not access or wildlife surveys.

project_description: Open Campus: UO develops this campus model and viewer. Its public upstream pipeline develops reusable reconstruction methods, automation and the browser template. Additional maps can build on the same template.
footer: Independent reconstruction project. No University of Oregon endorsement. Public development preview.
